layouts.name: Osnabruck Hill Climb
layouts.description: Draft open course: The event operator identifies the 2.030 km Uphöfener Berg hillclimb. The independently mapped open route measures approximately 2.023 km and both private timing positions agree with its endpoints. The supplied scalar course distance differs and is not used to stretch the geometry. Coordinates are unchanged independent OSM ways; no artificial closure or endpoint interpolation is added.
